_comment: Maps a ground-truth bug_class to keyword phrases that are surfaced in the side-by-side comparison bundle (under each bug's 'keywords') so the LLM/human grader has diff-diff's vocabulary for judging whether a review named this class of defect. The carved-back harness has no auto-scorer — these are read context, not a match rule. Keep phrases short (1-2 tokens) and lowercase. The engine treats them as opaque; only this corpus file knows diff-diff's bug vocabulary.
